title: Zimbabwe elected to UN Security Council
summary: The United Nations General Assembly on Wednesday elected ​Austria, Kyrgyzstan, Portugal, Trinidad and Tobago and Zimbabwe to the 15-member UN Security Council for two-year terms starting on January 1, 2027.
